title: builtin.air.kinematic parameters
description: Kinematic aircraft limits. Units are given by key suffix. The turn rate is g * tan(max_bank) / max(speed, 1 m/s), capped by max_turn_rate_dps; the target height is the MoveTo destination's height above the ellipsoid.

max_speed_mps.description: Maximum speed in meters per second.

min_speed_mps.description: Minimum speed in meters per second while flying; must be below max_speed_mps. With 0 the aircraft can stop on a destination.

max_accel_mps2.description: Maximum acceleration and deceleration in meters per second squared.

max_climb_rate_mps.description: Maximum climb rate in meters per second.

max_descent_rate_mps.description: Maximum descent rate in meters per second; defaults to max_climb_rate_mps.

max_bank_deg.description: Maximum bank angle in degrees (0 to 90, exclusive); sets the turn rate.

max_turn_rate_dps.description: Optional cap on the turn rate in degrees per second.

min_altitude_agl_m.description: Lowest allowed height above the terrain in meters; below it the aircraft climbs.
